1.name: Standard
1.description: Only the player whose turn it is guesses. A correct guess scores 1 point; a wrong guess earns an X.

2.name: Everyone may join a guess
2.description: When a player makes a guess, every other player may secretly guess the same target's identity too, then all guesses are revealed. The original guesser scores 2 points if correct; anyone else who joins scores 1. Every wrong guess earns an X.
